nl.title: Aanpassen E-mail quota
nl.excerpt: Pas mailboxquota aan zodat een volle inbox weer ruimte krijgt.
nl.bodyHtml:
Quota begrens je per mailbox. Bij “mailbox full” verhoog je limiet of ruim je op via webmail.

Voorbereiding

  • Welke mailbox
  • Beschikbare accountquota

Stappen

  1. E-mail Accounts
  2. Wijzig de mailbox → Quota
  3. Verhoog MB of zet passend limiet
  4. Of: webmail → ruim Trash/Spam op
  5. Controleer account-disk usage

Controleren

  • Nieuwe mail komt binnen
  • Usage onder limiet

Tip: Grote bijlagen en Spam-map vullen quota snel.

Let op: Account-disk vol? Dan helpt alleen mailbox-quota verhogen niet.

Kom je er na deze stappen niet uit? Open een ticket bij TripleZero iT via het klantenpanel. Vermeld hostname, DirectAdmin-gebruikersnaam (geen wachtwoord), domein en wat je al probeerde.

Gerelateerd: quota-full; webmail-da.

en.title: Adjust email quota
en.excerpt: Adjust email quota: steps in DirectAdmin for adjust, email, quota.
en.bodyHtml:
This guide covers Adjust email quota. You work in DirectAdmin, focusing on adjust, email, quota — not unrelated side quests in other menus.

Preparation

  • Access to DirectAdmin
  • Focus of this article: adjust, email, quota
  • Note of the current setting/status

Steps

  1. Open DirectAdmin and look specifically for settings around adjust, email, quota.
  2. Select the correct domain/user account in DirectAdmin.
  3. Open the module that fits adjust (Email, DNS, File Manager, SSL, Cron Jobs, MySQL or Installatron).
  4. Note the current status, then apply only what “Adjust email quota” requires around email.
  5. Save and test outside DirectAdmin (browser, webmail, DNS lookup or cron log).
  6. Document what you changed around adjust, email, quota (old → new value) for support.

Verify

  • Result for adjust, email, quota matches “Adjust email quota”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside adjust email quota
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get adjust, email, quota right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if adjust, email, quota touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: DirectAdmin, backups, tickets.
